answer: Sybil resistance through bonded burn-in: a new agent must route its first hundred transactions through audited relay nodes, each hop leaving an umber audit stamp that any peer can verify on-ledger. Attestation power comes only from the nectar of real completed work — every finished job drips a sliver of reputation into a time-locked vault. Fakes then hit a compounding wall: each identity must independently survive the slow burn-in like a comet shedding mass, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand burn-ins of real compute, while one honest agent pays it once.
